text_block_list.text: A month has passed since the Yayoi Sho.

Though the preparation period was short,
Satono Crown gave it her all.
No matter how little time she had—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
'Uma Musume Card: Mihono Bourbon'
Ooooopen!

text_block_list.name: Opponent Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Piece of cake! I'm turning over mine too—
"Umamusume Card: Neo Universe"!!
And I'll also play "Tactics Card: Ad Astra"!

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
!! It's "coming"! The climax of the Umamusume TCG
'UmaDuel Racer'...! The Homestretch Phase!
choice_data_list: Oh, giving it your all, Crown!
Ah, look at you go, Crown!

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
!?!? Who are you!?
Could you be the rumored—

text_block_list.name: Nearby Umamusume
text_block_list.text: The advisor to the runner, Satono Crown?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Quiet down! We are in the middle of a duel.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The stage where the two stand is the "Satsuki Sho."
Because it's Nakayama Racecourse, both players receive a "Challenge Card: Steep Slope."

text_block_list.name: Opponent Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
*Gulp*... That's it.
At this distance, she can get up to top speed!
My Neo Universe can catch them and win!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (...I see.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(In other words, you're the type
who primarily focuses on how to reach
your top speed on the final stretch.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (I see, devising a strategy from that angle—)
—It happened a while ago, when I took them out for some fun, knowing they shouldn't just push themselves too hard all the time.

text_block_list.name: Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
To celebrate the release of the new pack for the Umamusume TCG 'UmaDuel Racer'—the Duel Tournament!
The winner of the 1st tournament has been decideddddd!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I lost again...
My McQueen deck...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you don't know it?
It's a trading card game based on popular Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"You battle using tactic cards on a field modeled after a GⅠ
so that your favorite Umamusume can settle the score."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: The field changes every six-turn season, so it's crucial to figure out which field to grind RP on, but...
choice_data_list: Looks like there's more to it than meets the eye, huh...
Looks like there's more to it than meets the eye, doesn't it...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Really?
I'm sure you could pick it up in no time, Trainer.
The basic tactics are pretty similar to Umamusume racing, after all.

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Heheh. I win!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh...
choice_data_list: Diamond may have lost to that boy, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
Dia, on the other hand, is getting way too caught up in her own racing style.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That's classic Umamusume.
Even in "Uma Duel Racer," you end up relying on the tactics you're actually best at.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Even though the McQueen deck she's using
is a front-runner breakout type, Dia's tactics
have turned into a close-marking type.
...In other words, when an Umamusume plays this card game, she tends to adopt tactics that mimic her own running style.
choice_data_list: Is this game popular at the academy too?
Is this game popular at the academy as well?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yeah. The player base should be fairly large. Dia is one of them, after all.
choice_data_list: ...I see. In that case, we might be able to make use of it.
...I see. In that case, we might be able to make use of it.

text_block_list.name: Peer Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
All right, Kura-chan!
Next up, face my ultimate Chaser deck!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on!
Come at me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Trainer's suggestion wasn't bad at all.
This TCG really is quite unique.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (What's your best running style? How confident are you? How do you think in a crunch? ...This game brings that mindset for competition right to the surface.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (There's only one month between the Yayoi Sho and the Satsuki Sho. Right now, cramming in multiple mock races is physically impossible, so—)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: (If it's for researching rivals, I should use games or anything at my disposal.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I got data on two new contenders today.
One of them isn't entering the Satsuki Sho, but it looks like they're registered for the Derby.
choice_data_list: Got it, I'll organize it all later

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for your help.
In that case, the next rival data we need to get is—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Duramente-san, huh.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? You're a "competitor"
as well, Duramente-san!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu.
If that were the case, things would be simple, wouldn't they?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Duramente-san isn't a "contender," so when I asked for a mock race, she turned me down.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: And on top of that, whenever it's time for training, she wanders off on her own... and can't be found anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"It's best to view it that way.
It feels like it's deliberately being kept a secret, after all."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I haven't been able to update
Duramente-san's data since the Kyodo News Hai.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Well, but still!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ever since I lost to her, I've never once forgotten the way she ran.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
How should I run to beat her?
I've thought about that hundreds of times.
Ever since that day.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —So all that's left is to win.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, here it comes!
The first leg of the Classic Triple Crown, the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown has gotta be the favorite!
Her consistency up to the Yayoi Sho was insane!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: She's head and shoulders above the rest of her generation—hmm?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ...? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"—No, the odds were just updated.
At this rate... she might even overtake Crown in popularity?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No way.
No matter how good they looked in the paddock—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: ――...Hiiik!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Wha, wha-wha-what is it!?
What do you want!? You wanna go!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's with you all of a sudden?
Who do you think you're talking to?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...*pant*... *pant*, *gasp*... *gasp*!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Now, thank you all for waiting!
The crown of spring, the Satsuki Sho, is about to begin!!
